name: ASYMMETRIC_ISLAND_ACCESS_PAPER2_SOURCE_COMPARISON
ecological_primary_question: When does island isolation protect breeding seabirds from mammals yet constrain nonflying breeders' shore-to-nest access?

hypotheses.H_M: Mammal exposure × independently mapped nesting-guild predator reach conditional on bird species and survey availability, within Falklands.
hypotheses.H_F: Flightlessness × independent seasonal shore-to-nest terrain accessibility with matched flying controls, within Antarctic mammal-free context.
hypotheses.H_X: Crossover of physical refuge benefit and breeder land-route cost across matched flight/mammal statuses; not direct UK-versus-Antarctic binary comparison.

evidence.role: Within-archipelago mammalian introduced predator comparison containing penguins and volant seabirds
evidence.NOTES: Native invaders XLS lacks header; Norway rat labels include desktop-assessed absences; original FIBD bird Presence/Breeding status are columns, NOT independently validated repeated nondetection histories.

evidence.role: High-resolution species-specific penguin shore-access and nesting-substrate exploratory arm ONLY
evidence.NOTES: 3 candidate islands cannot become 122139 independent island replication; source 2019-20 observed nest-only mask is NOT unoccupied suitable habitat.

evidence.role: Candidate flying seabird controls; separate original survey programmes with mapped-habitat missingness
evidence.NOTES: P/A source programmes differ; AEI habitat availability is response-associated missing. Do not use a taxon-class interaction as if paired observation design.

evidence.role: Pygoscelis same-citation same-vantage temporal penguin source after geological/access covariate validation
evidence.NOTES: Penguin time-series stage, not directly comparable flying control nor established precise source nesting polygon.

evidence.role: Separate benchmark/counterexample; NOT predator-treated endpoint for integrated Paper2
evidence.NOTES: Source predator code0 assumed OR known absent. V44 nest-guild hypothesis NOT supported, negative magnitude not robust to two-census count model. V46 leader switching remains descriptive.

next_source_task: Within original Falklands FIBD island+bird+invasive matched records, count same-island penguin and flying confirmed breeding records by 1997-2013 survey year, and distinguish recorded rat-positive, independently surveyed rat-negative, desktop-assessed unknown. Check original bird completeness and direct survey-effort denominators before fitting any effect. No inference of true negatives from missing species/record.
main_manuscript: One original-data macroecology study centered on island asymmetric access; no separate predator SDM or penguin turnover papers.
